verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator (PCIe/OAM card) that runs on the customer's own servers. Data retention and deletion controls are a privacy-posture axis for services that hold user data, so the question is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the accelerator itself offering a data-custody service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
